run_boost_zstd_static_link_test: run the Boost.Build test that links a C++ executable against zstd as a static library
run_boost_zstd_shared_link_test: run the Boost.Build test that links a C++ executable against zstd as a shared library
run_boost_zstd_explicit_location_test: run the Boost.Build test that links zstd from an explicit include and search path location
run_boost_zstd_both_link_test: run the Boost.Build test that builds both static and shared variants of zstd linking
review_boost_zstd_test_scenarios: review the Boost.Build test scenarios covering zstd library static and shared linking configurations
